**Note on related PRs:**

- [PR #7140](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/7140) and [PR #7156](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/7156) add static default variant per agent
- My [PR #11377](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/11377) enables **dynamic** model selection via tiers at call time

These are complementary - agents can have default variants while still allowing tier-based overrides via Task tool.

Just ran into this on my Mac (M1/Bun v1.3.5) and managed to get it working.

The issue is that the installer (or a previous run) created the ~/.local/state folder with restricted permissions (owned by root), so OpenCode crashes because it can't create its own subfolders there.

If you're stuck with the EACCES error, just run this to take back control of the folder:

`sudo chown -R $(whoami) ~/.local/state
`

Worked like a charm for me after that! It might be worth checking if the install script can handle these permission checks automatically so others don't have to DIY a fix.

1. When `Glob` doesn't provide enough results, it's usually context problem. User didn't provide enough instructions or they're too vague. `opencode` can't be this smart and try follow symlinks. I've read through the discussion and the different approaches suggested (thanks @dkudos for the comprehensive analysis!).

I've implemented **Approach 6: Extension Suffix Matching** on my fork to solve the compound extension problem (`.blade.php`, `.spec.ts`, `.html.erb`, etc.).

## Implementation Details

**Problem:** The current `path.extname()` only extracts the last extension:

- `component.blade.php` → `.php` ❌
- `test.spec.ts` → `.ts` ❌

**Solution:** Added `extractExtensions()` function that extracts ALL possible extensions from most specific to most general:

```typescript
// For "component.blade.php"
extractExtensions() returns: [".blade.php", ".php"]

// Matching logic then checks if any formatter extension
// matches any of these file extensions
```

**Changes made:**

- Modified `packages/opencode/src/format/index.ts`
- Added `extractExtensions(filepath: string): string[]` helper function
